detailed_descriptions.en: One day, all of a sudden, you find yourself becoming a ghost. You've never committed any evil. Your soul would surely be judged favorably. ...Right? It no longer mattered how great of a place it was. The thought of being separated from him sounded more terrifying than abyss. You know what you need to do... If you can't visit him anymore... Then you have to bring him with you! You're sure he would understand. You need to bring him to your side before your soul passes on. You have to XXXX your beloved... This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost. The objective is to fulfill her desires by talking to her beloved "Him", causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing. However, as a ghost, you cannot easily communicate with "Him", who has no spiritual inspiration. Through trial and error, try to bring about the desired outcome. [Estimated Playtime] Main Story: Approx. 1–2 hours (Approx. 15 minutes per ending, with 6 endings in total.) Playtime may vary depending on your choices and pace. Side Stories: Approx. 1 hour (Includes the prequel "Prologue" and the sequel "Epilogue".) A Prologue; the story of your life before becoming a ghost, and an Epilogue; the story after the main story, have been added. Save function and ending list have been added, making the game even easier to play Illustration gallery and ending list are included as a reward for completing the game. [Streaming Guidelines] Permissible Recording Area: The main story and all side stories are permitted for streaming and recording. However, please refrain from the following: - Using spoiler scenes as video thumbnails. - Posting spoilers on social media. - Streaming or sharing the Gallery. For specific details and the latest information regarding streaming restrictions, please refer to our Fan Content Guidelines.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
One day, all of a sudden, you find yourself becoming a ghost.

You've never committed any evil. Your soul would surely be judged favorably. ...Right?

It no longer mattered how great of a place it was.

The thought of being separated from him sounded more terrifying than abyss.

You know what you need to do...

If you can't visit him anymore...

Then you have to bring him with you!

You're sure he would understand.

You need to bring him to your side before your soul passes on.

You have to XXXX your beloved...

This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost.

The objective is to fulfill her desires by talking to her beloved "Him", causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.

However, as a ghost, you cannot easily communicate with "Him", who has no spiritual inspiration.

Through trial and error, try to bring about the desired outcome.

[Estimated Playtime]

Main Story: Approx. 1–2 hours (Approx. 15 minutes per ending, with 6 endings in total.)

Playtime may vary depending on your choices and pace.

Side Stories: Approx. 1 hour (Includes the prequel "Prologue" and the sequel "Epilogue".)

A Prologue; the story of your life before becoming a ghost,

and an Epilogue; the story after the main story, have been added.

Save function and ending list have been added, making the game even easier to play

Illustration gallery and ending list are included as a reward for completing the game.

[Streaming Guidelines]

Permissible Recording Area: The main story and all side stories

are permitted for streaming and recording.

However, please refrain from the following:

- Using spoiler scenes as video thumbnails.

- Posting spoilers on social media.

- Streaming or sharing the Gallery.

For specific details and the latest information regarding streaming

restrictions, please refer to our Fan Content Guidelines.
